ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SQ AI uses your photo library so you can pick a video or photo to edit or design, and to save results in the SQ AI album.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SQ AI saves your finished photos and videos to your gallery, in the SQ AI album.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: SQ AI uses the camera to film your reel shots.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SQ AI uses the microphone to record your shots' sound.
